g.text: GEBETSZEITEN MIT SMARTPHONE & GOOGLE KALENDER VERBINDEN
Bait-us-Subuh Frankfurt · Official Timetable Sync Guide for Members
WHAT IS THIS APP & WHAT DOES IT DO?

An automated service that synchronizes the official mosque timetable directly to your Google Calendar. Whenever prayer times change weekly, your calendar updates automatically in the background without any manual typing.
✓ 100% Official Times (Fajr, Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) · ✓ Zero Weekly Maintenance · ✓ Works on Android & iPhone
⚠️ Audio Notice: The app does NOT have built-in audio or Azan files. Alerts are played through your phone's Google Calendar notification settings.
Add Prayer Times to Calendar (Main Method)
Method 1: Scan QR Code with Camera OR Click the Direct Button (100% Anonymous · No Login)
OPTION B: CLICK BUTTON ON PHONE DIRECTLY
Click to Add without SCAN directly
Direkt ohne Scan zum Kalender hinzufügen
No account login or password needed.
One-time setup in Google Calendar Settings: Enables timely notifications for all 5 prayers
Privacy rules prevent public feeds from sounding alarms automatically.
Once set, Google Calendar applies this rule to all 5 daily prayers:
Connect via OAuth 2.0: Event reminders and notifications are created AUTOMATICALLY
CLICK GOOGLE LOGIN BUTTON ON WEBSITE:
Sign in with your Google Account
1. Select your Google account on Google's consent screen
2. Grant permission to add events · Password is never shared
The sync engine automatically injects notifications into each event.

• Your phone alerts you automatically without setting calendar rules.
• To customize the ringtone sound (e.g. choose an Azaan MP3), see Step 4!
Best if you prefer ready-to-use automatic alerts without manual steps.
Set Your Desired Ringtone or Azaan (Both Methods)
The app does NOT have built-in audio: you choose your preferred tone in Android Calendar Settings
Phone Settings > Apps > Google Calendar > Sound
Whether Method 1 or 2, this sets the audio sound that plays.
The app syncs events only. All audio comes from your phone's calendar settings.
HOW TO USE AN AZAN MP3:
2. Move it to the phone folder:
3. It appears in the Sound list!
Device Guide: Android vs Apple iPhone (iOS)
Google Calendar App availability and recommendations by platform

✓ Pre-installed by default: Google Calendar comes on almost every Android device.
✓ If missing: Reinstall free from Google Play Store.
✓ Easily select personal MP3s for prayer alarms!

✓ Recommended: Download free Google Calendar app from Apple App Store.
✓ Provides full notifications, event colors, and reliable prayer sync.
✓ Apple's built-in Calendar can also subscribe, but uses standard iOS chimes.
